name: Generate a Seedance 2.5 AI short-film series with consistent characters and publish to TikTok, Reels and Threads with SocialRobot

parameters.content:
## Seedance 2.5 AI short-film series with consistent characters

Produces the next 30-second episode of your own AI short-film series on a schedule. The same original or fictional characters appear in every episode and the story continues from the last one.

### How it works
1. Every day at 18:00 the next episode not marked `done` is read from Google Sheets, with the previous episode's summary for continuity.
2. The cast's reference images come from the Characters tab.
3. OpenAI writes a timed multi-shot Seedance prompt, captions and an episode summary.
4. Seedance 2.5 on Replicate renders a 9:16 720p video with sound; the workflow polls, cancels after the timeout and validates size and duration.
5. SocialRobot sends the video to your **TikTok inbox as a draft**: nothing goes public until you post it in the app.
6. **Instagram Reel and Threads nodes are optional and off by default.** Once enabled they **post publicly** right away (the Reel carries the AI-generated label).
7. The Sheet row is marked `done` with post ids and the summary; failures mark it `failed` and stop with a readable reason.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Self-hosted n8n with the SocialRobot community node 3.1.1+ and your SocialRobot API key
- [ ] Build the sheet from the **Sheet Layout** note and paste its URL in **Set Film Series Parameters**
- [ ] Add Google Sheets, Replicate (Bearer Auth) and OpenAI credentials
- [ ] Connect TikTok in SocialRobot and pick the account in **Draft TikTok Post**
- [ ] Optional: enable **Post Video on Instagram** and/or **Publish on Threads** and pick accounts
- [ ] Before posting the draft in TikTok, **turn on the AI-generated content label** in the app

### Customization
- Change premise, style, length (max 30 s), resolution, model or hashtags in **Set Film Series Parameters**.
- Change the time in **When Clock Strikes 18:00**. SocialRobot does not publish to YouTube.

About $6.94 per 30-second 720p episode on Replicate (list price, Oct 2026). Uses a community node: self-hosted n8n only.

## Sheet layout
**Tab `Episodes`** (one row per episode, in order):
`episode` · `title` · `logline` · `characters` (comma-separated names) · `status` · `summary` · `tiktok_post_id` · `instagram_post_id` · `threads_post_id` · `produced_at`

**Tab `Characters`**:
`name` · `description` (look, clothes, personality) · `image_url` (public link to a clear, front-facing reference image)

Use only characters you created or have rights to. No real people, celebrities or look-alikes. Leave `status` empty for episodes still to make.

## Daily series setup
Runs daily at 18:00 and holds the series premise, visual style, Seedance model, length, limits and sheet URL.

## Select next episode
Reads the Episodes tab and picks the first row not marked `done` or `failed`, plus the latest finished episode's summary.

## Episode availability gate
Ends the run quietly when every episode is produced.

## Build cast and shots
Matches the episode's characters to their reference images ([Image1], [Image2], ...). OpenAI writes a timed multi-shot prompt, captions and a continuity summary. Fictional cast only, no real people.

## Submit Seedance generation
Sends a Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video job to Replicate (up to 30 s, up to 30 reference images, 480p or 720p).

## Poll generation status
Checks every 20 s until the job succeeds, fails or passes the timeout.

## Cancel timed out job
Cancels jobs that run past the timeout so they stop costing money.

## Download and validate video
Downloads the file (Replicate deletes outputs after an hour) and checks size and real MP4 duration.

## Create TikTok draft
Send to Inbox (Draft) mode: the video lands in your TikTok inbox and nothing goes public until you post it in the app.

## Publish Instagram Reel
**Optional, disabled by default.** Once enabled it posts a public Reel immediately, with the AI-generated label on.

## Post and close episode
Threads is **optional, disabled by default**; once enabled it posts publicly immediately. The row is then marked `done` with post ids and the summary for the next episode.

## Record publishing failures
Render failures, failed checks and SocialRobot errors mark the row `failed` with the reason, then stop. Clear `status` to retry.

## Turn on the TikTok AI label
The SocialRobot node does not send the TikTok AI label for inbox drafts. Open the TikTok inbox notification, switch on 'AI-generated content', then post. If you enable the Reel node, Instagram is labeled automatically.

assignments.name: series_premise
assignments.value: A shy robot barista and a stray cat run a tiny night cafe on a rainy Tokyo-style street. Gentle comedy, one small problem solved per episode.

assignments.name: visual_style
assignments.value: Cinematic 3D animation, soft neon light, warm color grade, shallow depth of field.
